text: Bret Easton Ellis's American Psycho was classified R18 in Australia under national censorship legislation in 1991, which required it to be sold in plastic and only to people over 18. In 1991 New Zealand's Indecent Publications Tribunal also gave the novel an R18 decision. Police later raided an Adelaide bookshop owner for selling copies that were not plastic-wrapped.
meta_description: American Psycho by Bret Easton Ellis: classified R18 in Australia and New Zealand in 1991; an Adelaide bookshop was raided over unwrapped copies.
